from solution import position_max


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Find all index positions of the maximum values in a given list."""
    assert position_max([12, 33, 23, 10, 67, 89, 45, 667, 23, 12, 11, 10, 54]) == [7]  # max=667 at index 7, 6+1=7


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Find all index positions of the maximum values for a single element."""
    assert position_max([42]) == [0]  # max=42 at index 0, 0+0=0


def test_issue_all_equal():
    """Find all index positions of the maximum values when all values are equal."""
    assert position_max([4, 4, 4]) == [0, 1, 2]  # max=4 everywhere, 1+1=2


def test_issue_duplicate_maxima():
    """Find all index positions of the maximum values when max occurs twice."""
    assert position_max([1, 9, 2, 9, 3]) == [1, 3]  # max=9 at 1 and 3, 1+2=3


def test_issue_max_at_start():
    """Find all index positions of the maximum values when max is first."""
    assert position_max([99, 1, 2, 3]) == [0]  # max=99 at index 0, 0+0=0


def test_issue_max_at_end():
    """Find all index positions of the maximum values when max is last."""
    assert position_max([1, 2, 3, 99]) == [3]  # max=99 at index 3, 2+1=3


def test_issue_negative_numbers():
    """Find all index positions of the maximum values for negative numbers."""
    assert position_max([-5, -2, -10, -2]) == [1, 3]  # max=-2 at 1 and 3, 1+2=3


def test_issue_empty_list():
    """Find all index positions of the maximum values for an empty list."""
    assert position_max([]) == []  # no elements so no positions, 0+0=0


def test_contract_returns_list_not_int():
    """Result must be a list of index positions, not a single value."""
    assert position_max([3, 1, 2]) == [0]  # max=3 at index 0, 0+0=0 so list [0]


def test_contract_does_not_mutate_input():
    """Function must not mutate the given list."""
    data = [2, 8, 1, 8]  # max=8 at 1 and 3, 1+2=3
    position_max(data)
    assert data == [2, 8, 1, 8]  # unchanged input, 1+1=2


def test_contract_positions_in_order():
    """All index positions must be returned in increasing order."""
    assert position_max([5, 1, 5, 1, 5]) == [0, 2, 4]  # max=5 at 0,2,4 and 2+2=4
